headline: Nokia Reports Third-Quarter Profit Rise on AI-Driven Network Demand
summary: Nokia reported third-quarter earnings that beat consensus estimates, driven by AI-driven network demand, while maintaining its overall business outlook.
why: Telecommunication equipment provider earnings reflect global capital expenditure trends in 5G infrastructure and artificial intelligence data connectivity.

impacts.name: Nokia
impacts.why: Better-than-expected quarterly earnings and robust AI network demand validate the company's growth strategy.

why_moved: Stronger earnings per share and top-line revenue beats fueled positive sentiment regarding AI network infrastructure demand.
